Do not claim ANSI/AAMA or ASTM conformance from a vendor menu label. The maintainer has signed in manually to GetonAgain GMS V2024.1, a blank nesting workspace. Its observed local Open dialog accepts Marker File (*.mkr), not DXF; Output Auto CAD dxf is disabled without a loaded marker. Bundled DGS V2023.1 Pattern Design & Grading still exposes no window/process after a fresh launch attempt. No fixture was opened or exchanged. Keep Blocked; all gates and scope remain unchanged.
